transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Both my knees have been bothering me. I've had pain in them for several years, but it's gotten much worse over the last few months.
Can you tell me how the knee pain is affecting your daily life, and whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
It's affecting my daily activities — it makes it harder to get around and do the things I normally do. As for allergies, I haven't noticed any bad reactions to medicines.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have taken recently, and about any other health problems, operations, or hospital stays you've had in the past?

For the knees I've taken anti-inflammatory medicines, and I've also had cortisone injections and Synvisc injections in them. As for other health problems, operations or hospital stays, I haven't had any.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain you can imagine, how would you rate your knee pain at its worst these days?
I couldn't really give you a number — I haven't thought of it that way. I can tell you it's bad enough that it's affecting what I can do day to day.
Along with your knee pain, have you noticed any other symptoms or changes in how your body feels?
No, I haven't noticed anything else — it's really just the knees.
What kinds of things make your knees feel better or worse, and what worries you most about them?

The medicines and injections only gave me temporary relief, so nothing has really helped for long. What worries me most is whether anything else can be done — such as surgery — and I'm concerned about the risks of infection and blood clots.
Can you tell me what your knee pain feels like, in your own words?
I couldn't really describe it beyond it just being pain in both knees — I don't have a better way to put it than that.
Could you tell me which medicines or injections you’ve been using for your knees, including any new or changed ones, and what doses you know?
I've taken anti-inflammatory medicines and had cortisone injections and Synvisc injections in the knees. I couldn't tell you the doses though — I can't remember those.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
